to form a $20B strategic partnership to employ their strengths across public and private markets in both equities and credit, the company said Monday.

J.P. Morgan Asset Management's partnership with QIA will start with two areas of collaboration: a $15B public equities mandate to support QIA's long-term investment objectives and a $5B private markets investment initiative focused on supporting established middle-market companies across the U.S.
The partnership is intended to position both organizations to capitalize on global investment opportunities and deliver sustainable long-term value, they said in a statement.
